shortLesson.text: Each turn starts with one draw. Press Your deck. This short match uses loaned cards: your collection is safe.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: You have 1 energy. Kim costs 1: the blue number. Yellow is attack; red is health. Drag Kim onto your side, or click her then Play.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: New creatures sleep until your next turn. End turn. Granny will draw and pass; then Kim can attack.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Draw first. Your energy grows and refills each turn.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Granny has 2 hearts and no blocker. Drag Kim onto her portrait, or click Kim then Granny. Each cast, attack or Activate uses one of your two activations. This hit takes one heart.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: End turn. Watch Granny change the Win rule. Rule cards affect both players.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Read the Win tile in Axioms. Granny has 1 heart. If Kim attacks her now, whose zero hearts will win the match?

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Your decision. You may attack, play your Win rule card, or use Kim’s Filter to bring Fate’s Reset sooner. Read their effects and choose. No pointer yet.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: A hit would make Granny win. Your Win rule card or Kim’s Filter can restore the original goal.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Play your Win rule card, or click Kim then Activate Filter. Filter uses her attack for this turn.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Zero hearts loses again. You changed the starting rule, so the same attack has a different result.

shortLesson.speaker: granny
shortLesson.text: Read Win: the enemy hero to zero hearts. For the last test, end turn. Granny will pass, then you will draw.

shortLesson.speaker: granny

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: This is the Fate track. After each round, your turn and then mine, it moves one step. It reached NOW, so a rule changed: creatures cost 1 less. Now draw.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: In 4 rounds, Fate comes back and resets all rules.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Both took 1 damage. Damage stays: the number in the heart shows the health left.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Khaby's own ability also took Astrophysicat's ability away. See: No ability.

fullStaticLesson.text: Billie Eelish has an Entrance: it works when you play her. Her Whisper takes away an enemy's special powers, like Guard. Drag her onto Khaby Llame.

fullStaticLesson.text: Khaby lost his Guard. The way to me is open.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Press End turn and watch my turn.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Shakirattle! 3 attack, and Elusive: tactic cards can't target her.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Khaby hit you for 1 heart. The pictures on the left, Recent plays, show what I did.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Your turn. Shakirattle hits hard. Let's deal with my creatures.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Draw first.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Tactic cards work once. Counterexample deals 3 damage. Khaby keeps hitting you, and Shakirattle is Elusive, so aim at Khaby Llame.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Khaby is defeated. That used one activation. Each cast, attack or Activate uses one. You have two per turn.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: A rule card changes a rule for BOTH players. Underdog: in a fight, only the LOWER attack hits. Drag it to the middle row.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: The tactic and rule used both activations. End turn. Granny will pass, then you will draw.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Let's test the new rule on my strongest creature. Under the basic rules Astrophysicat would fall. Under Underdog only the lower attack hits. Drag Astrophysicat onto Shakirattle.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Shakirattle took 1 damage. Astrophysicat took 0. Same cards, different rule, different result.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Now drag Billie Eelish onto my portrait.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Only 2 hearts left! Those two attacks used both activations.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Press End turn and watch closely.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: I played a rule card! Look at the Win tile.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Draw first. Then read Axioms before you attack.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: I have only 2 hearts left. But something changed. Read Axioms, then decide what to do.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Hint: what will the next Reset on the Fate track do to my new Win rule? Which of your creatures can move Fate?

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Careful! Now if MY hearts reach 0, I WIN. Don't hit me now. Read the Win tile.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Fate reset! All rules are back to the basics: my rule AND yours. Zero hearts loses again.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Check the Win tile: enemy hero to zero hearts. Drag Astrophysicat onto me.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: Filter and the attack used both activations. End turn. Granny will pass, then draw before your last hit.

fullStaticLesson.speaker: granny
fullStaticLesson.text: One heart left. Drag Billie Eelish onto me to win. Always read the rules before you attack.
